content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to SQL and Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: Filtering Data with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 4: Sorting Data with ORDER BY Clause
    - Lesson 5: JOIN Operations: INNER, OUTER, LEFT, RIGHT
    - Lesson 6: Aggregate Functions (COUNT(), SUM(), AVG(), MAX(), MIN())
    - Lesson 7: GROUP BY Clauses for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Querying: Subqueries and UNION ALL
    - Lesson 9: Data Manipulation Language (DML) - UPDATE, DELETE
    - Lesson 10: Database Optimization and Indexes

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 2: NumPy and Data Structures
   - Lesson 3: Reading and Writing CSV Files with pandas
   - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing Techniques
   - Lesson 5: Data Aggregation and Groupby in pandas
   - Lesson 6: Working with Time Series Data
   - Lesson 7: Data Visualization Basics (Matplotlib)
   - Lesson 8: Intermediate Data Visualization (Seaborn)
   - Lesson 9: Working with APIs and Web Scraping for Data Collection
   - Lesson 10: Introduction to SQLalchemy for Database Access

   Track: Statistics and Probability for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Fundamentals of Probability
   - Lesson 2: Descriptive Statistics
   - Lesson 3: Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode)
   - Lesson 4: Measures of Dispersion (Variance, Standard Deviation, Range)
   - Lesson 5: Correlation and Regression Analysis
   - Lesson 6: Hypothesis Testing: T-tests and Chi-square Tests
   - Lesson 7: Probability Distributions (Normal, Poisson, Binomial)
   - Lesson 8: Confidence Intervals and Error Propagation
   - Lesson 9: Introduction to Machine Learning Concepts
   - Lesson 10: Supervised Learning Algorithms (Linear Regression, Logistic Regression)

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
   - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values
   - Lesson 2: Removing Outliers
   - Lesson 3: Merging and Concatenating Datasets
   - Lesson 4: Transforming Data Types (Categorical to Numerical)
   - Lesson 5: Data Normalization and Standardization Techniques
   - Lesson 6: Handling Duplicates and Redundancies
   - Lesson 7: Text Preprocessing for Natural Language Processing
   - Lesson 8: Feature Engineering Strategies
   - Lesson 9: Dimensionality Reduction with PCA and LSA
   - Lesson 10: Time Series Analysis Techniques

   Track: Introduction to Excel for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Excel Basics (Navigating, Formulas, Functions)
   - Lesson 2: Advanced Formatting and Styling
   - Lesson 3: Using PivotTables for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 4: Working with Charts, Graphs, and Diagrams
   - Lesson 5: Introduction to Macros and VBA Programming
   - Lesson 6: Importing and Exporting Data from Excel
   - Lesson 7: Data Validation Rules and Error Handling
   - Lesson 8: Using Solver for Optimization Problems
   - Lesson 9: Introduction to Power Query (Get & Transform)
   - Lesson 10: Advanced Data Analysis Techniques with Excel (Data Tables, Goal Seek)

   Track: Tableau Basics for Data Visualization
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Tableau and Creating a Worksheet
   - Lesson 2: Connecting and Preparing Your Data in Tableau
   - Lesson 3: Basic Chart Types (Line, Bar, Area, Pie)
   - Lesson 4: Advanced Visualization Techniques (Treemaps, Heatmaps)
   - Lesson 5: Creating Dashboards and Storytelling with Data
   - Lesson 6: Filtering, Grouping, and Sorting Your Data
   - Lesson 7: Calculated Fields and Custom Aggregations
   - Lesson 8: Working with Geographic Data in Tableau
   - Lesson 9: Interactive Filters and Parameter Controls
   - Lesson 10: Sharing and Publishing Your Dashboards
